Job Description
Position Overview:
AI Talent, a pioneer in AI-powered solutions, is looking for a meticulous and experienced Software Tester to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for verifying the quality and performance of our AI applications by creating and executing test plans, identifying defects, and working closely with developers to ensure prompt resolution.
The ideal candidate will bring a solid grasp of software testing methodologies, sharp analytical skills, and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality AI software. Experience with test automation tools is a plus.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the development team and project stakeholders to understand software requirements and design comprehensive test plans and test cases for AI software applications.
Perform functional, integration, system, and regression testing to validate the performance, accuracy, and reliability of AI software products.
Identify and document software defects, including clear and detailed reproduction steps, in a bug tracking system. Collaborate with the development team to ensure timely resolution of issues.
Develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard software testing automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Appium, or Robot Framework) to streamline testing processes and improve test efficiency for AI software applications.
Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and test reports, to ensure comprehensive test coverage and facilitate knowledge sharing within the team.
Set up and configure test environments, including hardware, software, and data, to simulate real-world scenarios and ensure accurate testing results.
Continuously evaluate and enhance software testing strategies, methodologies, and tools to improve the overall quality and efficiency of testing processes.
Work closely with the development team, product owners, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify issues, and provide timely feedback on the quality of AI software products.
Collaborate with the QA team to establish and maintain quality standards, best practices, and processes across AI software projects.
Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in software testing methodologies, AI technologies, and industry best practices.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Must have at least 2 years of proven experience as a Software Tester, with a strong understanding of software testing methodologies and practices.
Experience in testing AI software applications and familiarity with AI concepts and technologies.
Solid knowledge of test management tools, bug tracking systems, and test automation frameworks.
Experience with software testing automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Robot Framework, or similar.
Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in software testing, such as Python or Java.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and isolate software defects effectively.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to meticulously follow test plans and test cases.
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
Relevant certifications in software testing, such as ISTQB, are desirable.
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + super

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Emergency Department Administrator

Part Time Position 3 nights a week (night shifts Mon-Sun)

Cabrini Malvern location

We're building for the better!

By 2036, more than 150,000 patients will look to us for healthcare every year.

At Cabrini Health we champion community, compassion and career fulfilment. Our teams are united by the shared purpose of making a meaningful contribution to exceptional, patient-centred care in well-resourced, world class facilities that inspire you to perform at your best and continuously grow professionally.

About the role

Our Emergency Department Clerks perform a valuable frontline role where they will often be the first point of contact for patients and visitors to Cabrini Hospital. The ED Clerk will join our broader Patient Services team and perform a range of vital tasks to help ensure the smooth operation of the Emergency Department. The successful candidate will have a keen interest in healthcare, exceptional interpersonal skills as well as a caring and empathetic approach. Applicants must be able to work across evenings Monday-Sunday between the hours of 21:15-07:15 and 21:30-7:30 (subject to change).

Key responsibilities include:

Accurately collecting information and creating patient records

Welcoming, registering and admitting patients

Discharging patients, including collecting payment of out-of-pocket cost

Submitting online claims to Medicare

Performing Health Fund Eligibility Checks

Maintaining patient records and ensuring confidentiality of information

Collaborating with healthcare professionals to ensure seamless patient care delivery

Handling switchboard functions from 23:00-07:00. Including answering and transferring phone calls.

Answering and announcing codes and met calls.

What we're looking for

Previous experience working in a similar role, ideally with medical records or familiarity with medical terminology preferable

Certificate IV in Hospital Administration or Business Administration (desirable but not mandatory) 

Billing experience and Medicare, MBS knowledge preferable

A true team player - collaborative, dependable, and equally capable of working independently when required 

Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with exceptional customer service skills and patient-focused approach

A keen eye for detail and accuracy, ensuring every task is completed to a high standard 

Comfortability dealing with patients, clinical staff and external stakeholders such as health funds in a professional, service driven mannger

Proficiency in basic computer applications including Microsoft Suite products

 Why join Cabrini?

Opportunity to increase your take-home pay with Salary Packaging up to $18,850 per year tax free

Attractive hourly rates plus 13 % superannuation, 17.5% annual leave loading and penalty rates for applicable hours

Access to a range of staff benefits including retail offers, fitness passport, discounted hospital services and savings on eligible private health fund services

Opportunities for career growth and professional development

Hospital located close to public transport with discounted Myki Commuter fares

Values driven organisation committed to delivering exceptional patient care

To view the position description, click here

Enquiries should be directed to: Julie Oliver Acting Director - Patient Administration T: 9508 1534 | M: 0409 792 622

Does this sound like your new role? Bring your skills and enthusiasm to Cabrini Health and help optimise the patient experience and health outcomes for our community.

Cabrini Health acknowledges the importance of creating a work environment that is welcoming, safe, equitable and inclusive for people of all backgrounds and abilities. Inclusion is core to our mission.

As part of our commitment to Reconciliation and Closing the Gap in employment related outcomes, we encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples.

Working for Cabrini

Cabrini Health is a Catholic, private, for-purpose health service located in Melbourne's southeast. Inspired by the mission and ethic of care of the Cabrini Sisters, providing quality, compassionate care to our community for more than 75 years.

There is something special about Cabrini Health. Our highly skilled staff and specialists incorporate clinical research, innovative models of care and state-of-the-art technology to deliver the best possible care and outcomes for our patients. We demonstrate our mission to serve our community through outreach programs that support asylum seekers, provide healthcare in rural communities and in underdeveloped countries.

Our size, reputation and growth strategy ensure genuine opportunities for our people to learn, grow and realise potential.

Our values: Compassion - Integrity - Courage - Respect

MANDATORY FOR ALL NEW STAFF TO CABRINI

Employment with Cabrini Health will be based on satisfactory background checks such as professional references, National Police Check, vaccinations for annual Influenza plus a Working with Children Check (WWCC) may also be requested. Vaccination for COVID-19 is highly recommended.    Click here to Apply now →

A Heavy Vehicle Mechanic needed for a permanent role in High Wycombe, paying $55ph + penalties/Super/overtime.   Your new company     A national company requires a Heavy Vehicle Mechanic for an immediate start for a long-term role leading to a permanent role, paying between $45-$50ph + penalties/Super and overtime available.     Your new role     Your new role as a Heavy Vehicle Mechanic will include, maintaining, diagnosing and repairing heavy-duty vehicles, including buses, trucks etc. Key responsibilities will include, performing routine services, diagnosing and repairing complex issues in engines, transmissions, and braking systems, conducting roadworthy inspections.    
 
 Diagnosis and troubleshooting: 
 Test drive vehicles to locate and identify faults, and use diagnostic tools and computers to diagnose problems. 
 Repairs and maintenance:
 
 Perform routine maintenance and complete repairs on diesel engines, transmissions, steering, and braking systems. 
 Dismantle, remove, overhaul, and reassemble engine assemblies and other components. 
 Repair or replace worn or defective parts. 
 Conduct safety and roadworthy inspections. 
 
 
 Specialised systems: Service and repair other systems such as cooling systems, air-conditioning, and suspension systems. 
 
    What you'll need to succeed     Along with previous experience, you will need a minimum of a Cert III in Heavy vehicle Mechanics.     What you'll get in return     You will receive between $55ph + super, with Saturday work and overtime available.     What you need to do now         If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
SPAR Express Clayfield is a neighbourhood convenience supermarket operating under the globally recognised SPAR banner, serving the local Clayfield community seven days a week from its Sandgate Road store. Our store is part of SPAR Australia Limited, an unlisted public company founded by independent retailers and formally established under the SPAR name in 2006. SPAR Australia is the Australian licence holder for the SPAR supermarket brand and today supplies groceries, marketing and retail support to around 300 independent supermarkets across Queensland, New South Wales, the ACT, the Northern Territory and the Pacific Islands. Its national operations are anchored by a large, technology-enabled distribution centre at Acacia Ridge in Brisbane, carrying thousands of dry, chilled and frozen grocery lines. SPAR is one of the world's leading contemporary retail groups, celebrated internationally for retail innovation, with millions of shoppers visiting SPAR stores worldwide every day. As a fast-growing brand in Australia, SPAR gives independent retailers the buying power, systems and marketing of a major network while keeping the personal, local feel that customers value.

Key Responsibilities
•	Plan and manage the store's product range, deciding on the mix of grocery, fresh, chilled and everyday convenience lines that best suits our Clayfield customers, and setting the inventory and service standards that keep shelves full and shoppers happy.
•	Develop and roll out purchasing and merchandising approaches that make the most of SPAR's national buying programs, negotiate with suppliers where appropriate, and set competitive retail prices that balance value for customers with healthy store margins.
•	Prepare and manage the store's operating budget, set sales and expense targets, and keep spending, wage costs and stock investment in line with financial goals.
•	Plan and run local promotional and advertising activity activating SPAR catalogue campaigns, in-store specials, signage and community initiatives to grow foot traffic, basket size and brand awareness in the local area.
•	Lead front-line customer service by example, assisting shoppers at the point of sale, resolving queries, and sharing product knowledge and usage advice to help customers find what they need and encourage repeat business.
•	Recruit, roster, train, coach and supervise store team members, building a motivated and capable team and ensuring everyone delivers consistent, friendly service.
•	Maintain accurate records of stock levels, deliveries, wastage and daily financial transactions, and reconcile takings and banking to keep store reporting reliable and up to date.
•	Champion a safe, clean and compliant store by upholding workplace health and safety, food-safety and hygiene requirements and ensuring the team follows all relevant regulations and store procedures.
•	Oversee stock ordering, receiving and rotation to minimise out-of-stocks and reduce shrinkage and spoilage across the store.
•	Monitor daily and weekly trading results, identify opportunities to improve performance, and put practical plans in place to lift sales and efficiency.
•	Work in partnership with SPAR field and support teams to implement network standards, systems and marketing programs at store level.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications
•	An AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma.
•	At least 1 year of relevant experience in a retail, supermarket or convenience environment.

Personal Attributes
•	A natural leader who motivates others and leads from the front.
•	Friendly, approachable and genuinely customer-focused.
•	Well organised, reliable and able to juggle competing priorities in a busy store.
•	Strong communicator who works well with staff, customers and suppliers.
•	Commercially minded, with an eye for detail and a focus on results.
•	Honest, trustworthy and takes ownership of the store's performance.
•	Flexible and adaptable, comfortable working across the store's seven-day trading roster.

What We Offer
•	Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation per annum
•	Hours: Full-time position, typically 38 hours per week
•	Location: SPAR Express Clayfield — Shop 3, 805 Sandgate Road, Clayfield, QLD 4011

How to Apply
If you are an enthusiastic retail leader ready to make our Clayfield store your own, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your resume together with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

result.description: Techi Triage Pty Ltd  Techi Triage Pty Ltd  (ABN  - 98686755126) is seeking a motivated and experienced ICT Support Technician to join our growing team on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical support, maintaining ICT infrastructure, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, and ensuring the smooth operation of our information technology systems. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with opportunities for professional growth and career development.   Benefits  Annual Salary of $76,000 - $82,000, excluding superannuation, based on your skills and experience. Possibility of career progression.   Task & responsibilities   Provide technical support to users by responding to software, hardware and network-related enquiries.  Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software and system issues in a timely manner.  Install, configure, test and maintain desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners and other peripheral devices.  Install, configure and update operating systems, business applications and security software.  Monitor ICT systems to ensure efficient operation and optimal system performance.  Assist with implementing and maintaining computer networks, including user accounts, connectivity and security settings.  Perform routine system maintenance, software updates, backups and data recovery where required.  Configure and support email systems, cloud-based applications and remote access solutions.  Maintain accurate records of technical issues, support requests, system configurations and maintenance activities.  Assist in maintaining website functionality and web-based applications where required.  Provide guidance and training to staff on the effective use of computer systems and software applications.  Liaise with third-party vendors and service providers for technical support and equipment procurement.  Ensure compliance with organisational ICT policies, cybersecurity standards and data protection requirements.  Recommend improvements to ICT    Qualification & experience   Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Systems, Networking or a closely related field (or equivalent qualification).  At least one year of relevant industry experience in ICT support, help desk or systems support. Applicants with extensive relevant experience may also be considered.  Demonstrated experience in troubleshooting Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, hardware and network connectivity issues.  Knowledge of LAN/WAN environments, networking principles, printers, peripherals and cloud-based technologies.  Excellent problem-solving, communication and customer service skills.  Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.  Relevant industry certifications (such as Microsoft, Cisco or CompTIA) will be highly regarded.
